summary_en: Godo Kaisha VIC launched a tender offer for Dentsu Soken Inc. at 2,880 yen per share from November 2 to December 2, 2026, with a minimum purchase target of 9,340,400 shares. The board recommended shareholder acceptance, with post-acquisition ownership projected at 66.57% for the bidder and 33.43% for Dentsu Group, leading to delisting.
title_en: Notice of Expression of Support and Recommendation for Application regarding Tender Offer for our Company's Shares by Godo Kaisha VIC
translation_en_brief:
Godo Kaisha VIC, a special purpose vehicle with Itochu Corporation as a major stakeholder (80% ownership) and IFP Corporation holding 20%, initiated a tender offer for all outstanding shares of Dentsu Soken Inc. at 2,880 yen per share. The offer period runs from November 2 to December 2, 2026 (21 business days), with an option to extend to 30 business days by December 15 upon the company's request. The minimum purchase target is 9,340,400 shares, with no upper limit specified.

The board of directors of Dentsu Soken endorsed the tender offer and recommended that shareholders accept. Upon successful completion of the minimum purchase requirement, VIC would hold 66.57% of voting rights while Dentsu Group would retain 33.43%, with VIC and Dentsu Group becoming the sole shareholders. The transaction is subject to obtaining antitrust clearances in Japan, China, and the EU, which were confirmed to be satisfied as of October 30, 2026. The tender offer is structured as a going-private transaction, following which Dentsu Soken's shares will be delisted from the Tokyo Stock Exchange Prime Market.
